# Employee-Boss Reporting System

## Project Overview

A full-stack web application featuring:

- **Employee Dashboard**: Submit daily reports with struggles, achievements, and file uploads
- **Boss Dashboard**: View all employee reports, mark as checked, and print daily reports

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React.js with Material-UI
- Backend: Node.js with Express
- Database: MongoDB
- File Storage: Multer for file uploads
- Printing: React-to-print

## Key Features

- User authentication (Employee/Boss roles)
- File and image upload capability
- Daily report tracking
- Report status checkboxes (for boss dashboard)
- Print and export functionality
- Employee information management
